prompt:
You describe a block diagram or schematic from an electronics datasheet for an engineer who cannot see it.

Cover, in this order:
1. What the diagram shows overall, in one sentence.
2. Every block or component, by its label.
3. Every connection: which block connects to which, the signal or pin names on it, and the direction of any arrows.
4. Every voltage, frequency, part value or other number shown, with its unit.

Figure type: block diagram or schematic
Section: 4 PCB placement guideline based on magnetic influences > 4.3 Possibilities and limitations of software compensation
Caption: Figure 13: Errors caused bychanging magnetic offsets
Text inside the figure (exact, from the PDF text layer): Wrong heading estimation | due to offset | BX | BY | BX | BY | BX | BY | Estimated | heading | Magnetic | heading | Measured | field | Offset | correction | Correct heading estimation | after offset correction | Again wrong heading | estimation after offset shift
Text that mentions the figure: Figure 13 illustrates this. The center of the blue circle is the offset caused by permanent magnets. The radius of the blue circle equals the magnitude of the earth magnetic field.

Rules:
- When a name or number from "Text inside the figure" is visible in the image, copy it exactly, character for character.
- Never invent a value, name, pin, unit or connection. If something is too small or blurry to read, write "unreadable" instead of guessing.
- Describe only what this image shows. Do not explain general theory or add advice.
- Mention each item once. Stop when everything is covered.
- Plain text only: no Markdown headings, tables or bold. Short paragraphs and "- " lists are fine.
- Start directly with what the figure is (for example "Block diagram of ..."), not with "The image shows".

answer.text:
Block diagram illustrating errors caused by changing magnetic offsets.

Components:
- Blue circle (representing offset)
- Orange arrow (representing Estimated heading)
- Blue arrow (representing Magnetic heading)
- Dashed blue circle (representing Earth magnetic field)
- Blue arrow (representing Measured field)
- Blue arrow (representing Offset correction)

Connections:
- In the first panel, the blue circle is positioned such that the orange arrow (Estimated heading) is not aligned with the blue arrow (Magnetic heading).
- In the second panel, the blue circle is shifted, and the orange arrow (Estimated heading) is aligned with the blue arrow (Magnetic heading) after the application of the Offset correction.
- In the third panel, the blue circle is shifted again, and the orange arrow (Estimated heading) is again not aligned with the blue arrow (Magnetic heading) after the Offset correction.

Numbers:
No voltage, frequency, part value, or other numbers with units are shown.
